SessionStart._comment: Kit self-update (v1.84): compares this project's kit files with the reference copy in ~/.claude/kit-template, updates obsolete/missing ones automatically (backups in Claude/logs/kit-backup), creates the genre skill folders, ingests community packs from the skills 'incoming' folder, and tells you to restart the session when files changed. Needs Python 3; silent no-op without it or without the template copy.

Only fires when you launch `claude` fresh (matcher 'startup'), not on every /clear or /compact. If the optional Agent Console is installed on this project, deterministically ensures its server is running AND correctly scoped to THIS project (killing and replacing a stale/wrong-project server bound to the same port if needed), then opens it in your default browser automatically, before Claude's first reply — no permission asked, nothing to answer. On Windows without bash available, use session-start-reminder.ps1 (already set below); with bash/WSL/Git Bash you can switch to session-start-reminder.sh.

hooks.command: echo "Reminder: only if tasks were closed this session and not yet recorded, make ONE batched planner-docs call - never one per reply."

PreToolUse._comment: Feeds the optional real-time Agent Console (Claude/hooks/agent-console.html) — logs the moment a subagent starts. Matched on the internal tool Claude Code uses to invoke any subagent (coder, qa-regression, and so on) — observed as either 'Task' or 'Agent' depending on the Claude Code build/version, so the matcher (regex) and agent-console-log.ps1/.sh both accept either name. Safe to remove this block entirely if you don't use the console; agent-console-log.ps1 silently does nothing without it either way.

Feeds the optional real-time Agent Console's 'MCP Server' node — logs the moment a call to the UEFN MCP server starts, and who made it (a bot's agent_type, or the main/chief-of-staff session). Same matcher as the PostToolUse after-playtest.ps1 block below, but a separate independent hook — MCP calls are synchronous, so PreToolUse/PostToolUse (not SubagentStop) is the right pair here. Safe to remove if you don't use the console.

Skill Harness (v1.82): counts when the coder reads a genre skill (~/.claude/skills/genre/...) so the Skills page can show real usage. Does nothing for any other file. Safe to remove; the Skills page then just shows 0 consultations.

SubagentStop._comment: Feeds the optional real-time Agent Console — logs the moment a subagent ACTUALLY finishes. Deliberately not a PostToolUse hook on the dispatch tool: for a subagent dispatched to run in the background, PostToolUse fires the instant the dispatch returns, not when the work is actually done (confirmed via a real test where the console showed 'finished' seconds after 'started' while the agent was still working) — SubagentStop is the hook Claude Code fires on real completion either way. Safe to remove if you don't use the console.

PostToolUse._comment: The 'unreal-mcp' server exposes a single generic dispatcher tool (mcp__unreal-mcp__call_tool) for ALL of its toolset actions: the tool name alone can't distinguish 'stop the play-session' from any other call (start, query, etc). So the matcher fires on EVERY call_tool call, and the real filter (only session/game stop actions) lives inside the hook script, which reads the hook's JSON payload from stdin. On Windows without bash available, use after-playtest.ps1 (PowerShell, already set below); if you have bash/WSL/Git Bash you can use after-playtest.sh instead, updating 'command' below.

hooks.statusMessage: Running automatic bug/regression check after the playtest...

PostToolUse._comment: Feeds the optional real-time Agent Console's 'Tokens this session' stat (experimental/best-effort — see agent-console-tokens.ps1's own header for details and caveats). Deliberately has NO matcher, so it fires after every tool call, not just subagent ones — token usage happens on every turn. Reads incrementally so this stays cheap even in a long session. Safe to remove if you don't use the console.

SessionEnd._comment: When the session ends (exit, /exit, logout) the Agent Console server of THIS project is stopped. Not on /clear or resume.
